They give the player access to the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} and [[Heart of the Mountain]] after they reach {{Skill|Mining|12}} and in exchange for {{Green|15}} enchanted versions of any type of [[Ores]]. == Interface == {{/UI}} == Dialogue == {|class="wikitable" ! colspan="2" | Condition ! Random Dialogue |- | class="ct" rowspan="2" colspan="2" | After Giving [[Ores]] | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &dRhys&f: I had a sunburn once, I have stayed down there ever since.}} |- | {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &dRhys&f: You can ask the &bLift Operator &ffor a ride to the &2Dwarven Mines&f!}} |} == Tips == *The best ore to mine for '''Rhys'''{{'}}s quest to unlock the [[Dwarven Mines]] is {{Item|Redstone Ore|text=Redstone}}, since {{Green|640}} can be bought from the {{NPCSprite|Mad Redstone Engineer}} and it has a high base drop rate. **If the player wants to avoid being attacked by {{MobSprite|Redstone Pigman;Redstone Pigmen}}, {{Item|Lapis Lazuli Ore|text=Lapis Lazuli}} is a close second. == Trivia == *Completing '''Rhys'''{{'}}s quest grants the {{ach|Resourceful|ach=true}}. *When the {{Zone|Dwarven Mines}} update first launched, Rhys wouldn't take the items to complete his quest. This turned out to be a bug with the SkyBlock Addons mod, one of the most popular mods for SkyBlock. Before this was fixed in SkyBlock Addons, there were rumors that the Dwarven Mines had been disabled by the admins to fix bugs, which was untrue. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jul 15|Updated [[Crystal Hollows]] description in the '''Rhys'''{{'}}s menu.}} |beta= {{History|0.11|[[File:Rhys.png|26px]] Added '''Rhys'''.}} {{History|Unknown|Fixed being able to complete '''Rhys'''{{'}}s quest with 30 of the same item by switching lobbies.}} {{History|2026/Jul 22|Updated [[Crystal Hollows]] description in the '''Rhys'''{{'}}s menu.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}} {{Nav/Dwarven Mines/NPCs}} [[Category:Deep Caverns]]
